scope: Source-reviewed user task families across the current desktop, phone, and web surfaces. This is the first product map, not an exhaustive control registry or a runtime-certified walkthrough library.

statusDefinitions.wired: UI and supporting code path found; runtime behavior not verified in this map.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some implementation exists, but a current UI/wiring gap prevents or limits the task. Read limitations.
statusDefinitions.unverified: Surface located, but end-to-end task behavior needs further inspection and testing.

entrypoints.note: The design directory contains the active desktop UI. Legacy route registry entries are not authoritative. Some older modules, notably Cloud and Themes, are deliberately embedded in current Settings.

updatePolicy.recommended: Review the map in the same change as its UI/behavior changes. Run source check before publishing or shipping guides.
updatePolicy.note: The checker flags changed source areas and task evidence. It does not update explanations, certify features, or run in the background.
updatePolicy.automaticControlIndex: Vite rebuilds literal control inventory and source revision on code edits/additions/removals and each build. This does not invent task semantics, authorize arbitrary controls or certify execution.
